_meta.note: Captured off the wire from `droid exec --output-format acp` 0.225.2, driven directly over stdio with an isolated HOME and a placeholder FACTORY_API_KEY (no real credential). The session id is replaced by a placeholder and the model catalog is cut to the current model plus two. A session/prompt whose text is /compact. The harness does not intercept it as a command: it re-arms its mode, sends the text to Factory as an ordinary turn (which the placeholder key fails with a 401), and the prompt is persisted as the session's title. So /compact is not a manual compaction on this ACP surface.
